lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in four primary horizontal tiers, extending from the posterior gill margin toward the caudal region with a semi-regular inter-blob distance.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows to form a grid-like pattern of high-contrast nodes along the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal feature running across the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient transitioning from a light dorsal edge to a shadowed ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple high-luminance filiform projections trailing from the posterior distal margin of the pectoral fin.
